annotations.title: List the calculators and their reference data

description: Lists every calculator on this server, with the standard behind it and whether it is the whole-system sizing calculator or one of the single-method ones, plus the reference data a caller needs to build a valid request: the compass directions and their orientations, the shading descriptions, the twenty-five solar postcode zones, the eight heat pump design locations with their design temperatures, the room types and their internal design temperatures, the heat loss element kinds, the occupancy archetypes and the fuel types. Call this when a value must be one of a fixed set and you are not sure what the set is.
name: list_calculators

tier.description: 'simple' for the whole-system sizing calculator, 'advanced' for the ones that each implement a single published method.

compassDirections.description: The eight compass points the sizing calculator accepts, with the orientation in degrees from south that each maps to.

orientation.description: Degrees from due south, as MIS 3002 measures it.

flowTemperatureOptions.description: The four flow temperatures the heat pump sizer compares, with what each usually means for the emitters and an indicative seasonal efficiency.

fuelTypes.description: Heating fuels a running cost comparison can be made against.

kwhPerUnit.description: Energy in a single unit of that fuel.

typicalEfficiency.description: Seasonal efficiency of a reasonable appliance burning it, as a decimal.

unit.description: The unit the fuel is normally metered or bought in.

heatLossDesignLocations.description: The eight locations MIS 3005-D tabulates outside design temperatures for.

designTempA.description: Hourly dry-bulb temperature exceeded for 99% of the hours in a year.

designTempB.description: The colder 99.6% figure. Using it removes the need for any uplift for intermittent heating.

heatLossElementKinds.description: The kinds of surface a room loses heat through, and which temperature difference each uses.

insulationLevels.description: Fabric descriptions for the heat pump sizer's fallback route. Indicative readings of British housing stock, not MCS figures.

occupancyArchetypes.description: The three MGD 003 weekday occupancy patterns.

propertyTypes.description: Building shapes, and how much each changes an exposed-surface estimate.

roomTypes.description: Room types and their minimum internal design temperatures.

shadingLevels.description: Shading described in words, each anchored to a segment count on the MGD 005 sunpath chart.

sunpathSegments.description: The equivalent count on the MGD 005 sunpath chart, out of 84.

solarPostcodeZones.description: The 25 MCS solar zones. Resolved automatically from a postcode, so only needed when a postcode is unavailable.
